scope: Matched inference only; no feature encoder, data loading, host-device transfer, model loading, control loop or accuracy measurement is timed.
device_phase_order: CPU before CUDA within each fresh per-case process
cuda_timing: perf_counter_ns wall latency; device synchronize immediately before and after every timed full-forecast call
cpu_timing: perf_counter_ns wall latency of each full-forecast call
cuda_memory: PyTorch peak allocated/reserved bytes after warmup; model and inputs resident; also allocated peak minus resident allocation. Excludes CUDA context and non-PyTorch allocations.
cpu_memory: Fresh-worker process RSS high-water through CPU phase, including Python/libraries/model loading. No isolated CPU tensor allocator peak is claimed.
persistence: One row per task, zero parameters, commands ignored, raw observed feature repeated to materialized [1,59,6144] output using expand(...).clone().
missing_device_policy: Report unsupported; never invent CUDA rows or mark the combined protocol passed.
data_access: Only existing exported training-input fixture NPZs; no original datasets, cache, validation or reserved payloads.
publication: Local resource report only; no paper, site or scientific metric updates.
